name: Kent Gida Maddeleri Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Kent Gida Maddeleri Sanayii ve Ticaret A.S. manufactures and sells confectionery, chewing gum, chocolate, and cocoa products in Turkey and internationally. The company also trades in chocolate. It sells chocolates under the 5 Star, Alpen Gold, Cadbury, Cadbury Dairy Milk, Côte d'Or, Daim, Freia, Hu, Lacta, Marabou, Milka, and Toblerone brand name; biscuits under Barni, belVita, Chips Ahoy, Club Social, Enjoy Life Foods, Honey Maid, Kinh Do, LU, Oreo, Prince, Ritz, Tate's Bake Shop, Tiger, Triscuit, TUC, and Wheat Thins brand name; and baked snacks under 7Days, CLIF, and Perfect Snacks brand names.
